meta.title: Modern Luxury Bedroom 1 (4.9m x 4.0m) - King Bed, Dressing Mirror and Lounge Nook

physical_properties.bed: king size (approx. 1.83m x 2.03m mattress) upholstered bed with tall channel-tufted ivory boucle headboard mounted on a freestanding walnut-panelled headboard wall, slim low-profile frame, bed floating in the middle of the room
physical_properties.bedding: crisp white sateen sheets, champagne silk-look duvet folded back at the foot, layered euro shams and two lumbar pillows in taupe velvet, chunky knit throw draped at an angle
physical_properties.nightstand: two walnut veneer nightstands, about 0.5m wide each, with fluted drawer fronts, brushed brass pulls and travertine tops
physical_properties.lamp: sculptural ceramic table lamp with pleated linen shade, switched off
physical_properties.finish: rich mix of matte, velvet, boucle and brushed metal textures

midground.notes: stack of two coffee-table books, small brass tray with a glass carafe, a bud vase with a single white ranunculus, a slim gold alarm clock
sculptural taupe boucle lounge chair, round travertine side table with a cup of coffee and an open book, slim brass arc floor lamp

background.notes: freestanding walnut-panelled half-height wall with integrated warm LED strip along the top edge (off), glimpse of the doorway to the ensuite visible past one end
small blown-glass pendants on brass rods, off

2.3m wide x 1.54m high window with a 0.56m sill, sheer ivory curtains and greige linen drapes pulled open, both hung from a slim white track fixed flush to the underside of the flat ceiling, fabric falling from ceiling to floor, soft view of greenery outside; not a door, no balcony
floor-to-ceiling vertical fluted walnut panelling 2.0m wide, centred on the bed, slim LED strip at the top; no TV, no TV unit, nothing mounted on it
0.9m x 2.0m full-length mirror with slim brass frame, beside the fluted feature panel
0.6m wide wall-hung walnut drawer with travertine top and brass pull, top at 0.95m

surface.details: wide-plank light oak floor with a plush cream wool rug under the bed

background.texture: limewash plaster wall in warm greige

palette.notes: ivory, greige and taupe base with champagne brass, walnut and a touch of deep slate

atmosphere.mood: serene, elegant, boutique-hotel calm on a fresh morning

camera.focus_point: whole room: king bed in the foreground and center, fluted walnut feature wall on the right, lounge chair and south window on the left
camera.position: standing just inside the entry door in the north-east corner, looking diagonally south-west across the room toward the corner where the feature wall meets the south window

lighting.key_light_source: morning sunlight through the 2.3m wide south window, filtered by sheer curtains
lighting.notes: soft sunbeams falling across the bedding, gentle shadows, no artificial lights on

style.rendering: photorealistic interior photography, architectural digest editorial quality
avoid: wardrobes or tall cabinets in the bedroom
style.scale_notes: ceiling is a standard 2.4m, keep proportions realistic: headboard wall 1.2m, window sill 0.56m and head 2.1m, feature panelling floor to ceiling

room_layout.bed_wall: king bed aligned on the centre line of the 0.9m walkway between the robes (about 2.85m from the north wall, 0.4m south of the room centre), headboard on the east side facing west toward the fluted walnut feature wall
room_layout.window_wall: south wall (4.0m): one window 2.3m wide x 1.54m high, sill about 0.56m above the floor and head at about 2.1m, centred on the wall (0.85m of solid wall each side); dressed with a slim white curtain track surface-fixed directly to the flat ceiling, running about 0.15m past each side of the window, sheer ivory curtains and greige linen drapes pulled open, so the window reads larger; to the bed's left as you lie in it
room_layout.entry_door: 0.9m wide door in the east wall at the north-east corner, coming in from the hallway, hinged at the north end and swinging into the room to rest against the north wall; its swing stays clear of the headboard wall and nightstand
room_layout.ensuite_opening: 0.9m wide opening in the east wall between the two walk-in robes, leading to the ensuite; hidden behind the freestanding headboard wall
room_layout.clearances: east-west across 4.0m: 0.7m walkway + 0.1m headboard wall + about 2.15m king bed + about 1.0m walkway to the feature wall; north-south along 4.9m: bed centred at about 2.85m from the north wall, about 1.9m between the north side of the bed and the north wall, about 1.1m between the south side of the bed and the south window
room_layout.headboard_feature_wall: freestanding headboard wall 1.2m high, 0.1m thick and about 2.9m long (bed plus two nightstands), set 0.7m west of the east wall, centred on the robe walkway so it screens it from the bedroom; about 1.4m clear at the north end (entry door side) and 0.6m at the south end
room_layout.opposite_wall: the long west wall facing the foot of the bed: floor-to-ceiling fluted walnut feature panelling, 2.0m wide, centred on the bed; no TV
room_layout.lounge_nook: south-west corner, between the feature wall panelling and the south window, beside the foot of the bed: sculptural taupe boucle lounge chair angled toward the view, round travertine side table, slim brass floor lamp, small round wool rug; the chair sits partly in front of the west end of the window, below sill height for its seat, catching the daylight
room_layout.orientation: room runs north-south; west wall (feature wall) 4.9m long, north and south walls 4.0m and solid apart from the south glazing; east side has the entry door (north end), the robes and the ensuite opening
room_layout.ceiling: flat plasterboard ceiling at 2.4m, painted warm white; no bulkheads, no recessed curtain pelmet or cove

feature_wall.panelling: floor-to-ceiling (2.4m) vertical fluted walnut panelling about 2.0m wide, centred on the bed, with a slim LED strip integrated into the top of the panelling (no ceiling cove)
feature_wall.notes: no TV and no TV unit; nothing mounted on the panelling

room_layout.mirror: full-length mirror 0.9m wide x 2.0m high on the west wall at its north end (0.55m to 1.45m from the north wall), bottom 0.15m above the floor, slim brushed-brass frame; side-lit by the south window
room_layout.dressing_zone: open floor in front of the mirror and drawer: about 1.2m to the north nightstand and about 1.7m to the side of the bed; north wall otherwise plain plaster
room_layout.small_drawer: one small wall-hung walnut drawer in the north-west corner on the north wall, 0.6m wide x 0.35m deep x 0.18m high, top at 0.95m, travertine top, brass pull, soft LED glow underneath; for combs and small items; styled with a brass tray, perfume and a bud vase
